V02-0001.statement: Plain words: stage 3 replaces the base outline maker with a composer building every building (not only manors) of wings, blocks, towers, courtyard, porch, dormers, chimneys; class, prosperity (smoothly, never a switch) and plot decide the shape (hovel one short low range; cottage lean-to; town house back range, dormers, door hood; rich merchant H-plan or three ranges round a forecourt; great manor four ranges round a courtyard with gate hall, towers, stair turret; inn galleried courtyard in a rich street, L-shaped alehouse in a poor one).

V02-0002.statement: Plain words (fit and view): faces its street, stays inside the site-plan region (never over street or neighbour), main door on the street side (never doorless; FM leaves about one in seven doorless), towers never through a wing; sizes in metres (hovel range about 4 m wide, manor 7-9 m); city zoom shows plan masses with courtyards and towers; district zoom roofs (ridges, hips, valleys, cones) lit by the sun; clicking a neighbourhood adds dormers, porches, chimneys; clicking a building composes rooms and with V03 its plan; detail kept once generated, marked stale and redone on next click when something changes, unchanged parts stay.

V02-0003.statement: Plain words (change of use, editing): a house becoming an inn keeps its range and grows side ranges round a yard, reverting removes them; a declining manor keeps its shell, hall no longer held (V03 divides), recovery restores it; brewer shop to brewery keeps its front and gains a yard; a split business is two ordinary buildings, merging back one undoable step. Building tool edits wings, towers, back ranges, tower shapes, storeys, roof shapes, porch/hood, dormers, hall/gate hall/chapel ends; clerk explains ('why is this manor an H?'); each change one undo step touching only that building and plot; the tool never says a plain no (bends with one line: stairs inside a solid pyramid seals it; removing the last wing removes the building; a tower beside a stepped temple is built on the ground); only a SettlementForge fact and a lock refused.

V02-0004.statement: Plain words (rules, sun, crypts, item 110, speed, limits): shapes written once per kind of building (about thirty kinds, four wealth levels) covering about two hundred trades, village buildings and SettlementForge custom buildings; class touches (manor courtyards and towers, longhouse down the slope with byre at bottom, watermill wheel on water, windmill round tower with sails, cathedral twin west towers with spires and often a crossing tower, market hall on an open arcade, round kiln, landmark cupola); larger and richer laid larger; misfit steps down courtyard -> U -> L -> single range; free choices lean to the sunny side without turning from the street; cathedral always has a crypt, on wet ground a raised choir over a dry crypt; new wing over a hidden cavern or ruin may break through; catacombs never made by a building. Stepped buildings (stepped temple, terraced palace, tiered tower) each tier casting its shadow; decks (bridge, pier, quay platform, mole) carry small light buildings, no cellar, tower or fort at a mole head; a chapel with a recorded crypt never on a bridge; houses under a new viaduct's piers or arches give way. Arena oval. Metropolis of 50 000 adds about 0.03 s to first map (about 3 %); roof detail within about 0.1 s of a click. Materials change colour and texture only (owner 2026-09-26); fantasy shapes rare by default, FM preset turns them to FM's mix; plans V03, close-ups V01, change over decades V06.

V02-0005.statement: Builds stage 3 to build depth: the BuildingGenerator registration replacing the base's OutlineBuildingGenerator (§2.6 'The stage-3 hook and its cost contract'): (1) the massing = stage 3's outline(), eager per-building at S11, composing the plan from a path of wings, blocks, towers, back range and court fitted to the site-plan slot, oriented by frontage, in metres, output the base wings (Building.wings) read by footprint, heights, shadows, 3-D export, capacity (model data, in digest); (2) the composition = compose(), the lazy wings and rooms rungs (dormer rows, porch, composed towers, courts, principal rooms hall, gate hall, tower rooms, chapel) keyed per wing; (3) the roofscape, one derived roof plan per building resolving every joint (mitre, valley, wall, gable, hip) and tower; (4) the diversity ladder per class and band as composition.json tables interpolated along prosperity (item 19); (5) mutation (item 18 on wings); (6) elaboration by click, editing, rendering, exports, METROPOLIS budgets, tests, FM parity, build plan.
