V02-0085.statement: Consumes §8.1, §8.2 (roofConstruction, states, roof tint by band), §8.4 (surface layer, casters), §8.5 (bands, change markers), §8.6 (stage-3 LOD, roof construction), §8.10 (roof detail) (roofscape BCR-V2-15; paint programs); §4.9 ClimateTable (ClimateRow.roof typed by V11 §2.8; M11 pitch, M12 flat roofs); §10.2 DesignationTemplateRow, BuildingClassRow.templateFamily, HeightsRow (BCR-V11-1, -8; composition column BCR-V2-09; heights columns BCR-V2-26); §11.1 exports (V2 §5.5); §12.4, §12.5, §12.7, §12.8 (V2 §6); §13.2, §13.3, §13.5, §13.6 (V2 §7); §14, §15.1, §16, Staged (@plat/buildings BCR-V2-18; FM rows BCR-V2-19; M6 BCR-V2-20).

V02-0086.statement: Item 110 and second-revision hooks: §2.6 base outline builder, deriveBase, capacity, Storey.wings, Basements, BuildingInput (BCR-V2-31 - BCR-V2-34, BCR-V2-39); §2.7 Bridge.deckCm, §4.8 piers', moles', quays' deck heights, item 110 (d) deck plots (via DeckContext); §8.4 casters and ceiling, §8.6 per-wing constructions (V2 §5.6; BCR-V2-36); item 110 (a)-(f) as revised ~23:40 (V2 §3.15-§3.17); §2.6 Heights and datum, §7.3 (a) 4, §7.4 warp and moveVertex, carry rule (2) (rebaseStack, BCR-V2-32 extended; wall-side sample BCR-V2-42); §4.11 step 8 heightsAt (BCR-V2-40); §2.6 Entrances rules 1 and 5 (BCR-V2-41; forecourt U door BCR-V2-38); item 101 R2 (every structural limit a named bend, J-V2.79); §2.6 interface Basement, terrain gate's §5.3 list, plan rung step 5, §5.3 basement row, §7.4 warp check, §10.2 cellar comments, §13.2 T29-4, J-A29.25 (BCR-V2-33 (a)-(d); step 3 and T28-3 are V03's BCR-V3-32).

V02-0087.statement: Out of scope: plan rung (plan, room programmes, interior ladder, stairs, F-PLAN) V03 (V02 hands the composition and dormer rows); neighbourhood close-ups and click V01 (V02 answers its wings-rung request); mutation over epochs and Works (item 67; item 18 (c)) V06 (V02 supplies recorded wing steps); every other rule table V11 (V02 owns composition.json schema and default rows); app screens and clerk V09, V10 (V02 defines events, handles, clerk operations).

V02-0088.statement: Out of scope: castles and wall towers stay the base's (keep class uses the base template, V2 §3.3 template family); underground buildings' vaults and islands' bases V04, V05 (the massing gives an underground building a single range with a flat roof, V2 §3.10.6 @underground rows; island rim cliff barrier and rim-slab crypt vault V05's); materials texture and colour only (MaterialRow V11 §3.19; materialFamily never reaches massing; owner 2026-09-26; T-V2-25); siting profile item 103 is S10b's and V11's (only emits.smoke and needs.runningWater shape massing); crypt's ring, size, rank are §2.6's basement function with V11 crypt, cryptM2, rankShare (BCR-V3-20; V03); catacombs V04's, under cemeteries or a CITY/METROPOLIS quarry ossuary, no V02 path makes, moves or shrinks one.

V02-0089.statement: Item 110's other homes: RetainingWall record, sources, drawing; raised ways, arena parts, piers, ramps, stairs, vaults, generation at CITY/METROPOLIS or declaration at TOWN; deck plots themselves; second fixture's skeleton and bars (V12) are the base's and named volumes'; which classes build in tiers with chance and cap and the deck budget row V11's (X16, X17); plans of tiers V03 (X18); ruin decay V04 (X19). V02 designs the building part only.

V02-0090.statement: Data model units the base's (integer cm on the lattice, centidegrees, table cells in declared units per §7.6's {value, unit, provenance, calibratable}, converted to cm at read and snapped); records are persisted (building leaf digest and snapshot), lazy (held in elaboration cache outside both digests until an edit stores it) or derived at read (pure, never stored); V02 adds no entity kind: every new record is a sub-record of Building (lifecycle its building's; a lock on it an attribute-level lock on its path).

V02-0091.statement: WingRole = main (the range the entrance hint names), range, cross (cross-wing through the main range's end at a butt joint), block (pavilion splitting the range it straddles; always hipped, never a pyramid, item 59 ADOPTED, J-V2.3; often a storey taller), back (rear range or outshot), service (lower range of the same building), tower (polygon wing with cone or pyramid roof at a corner, end, front, or on a block; church west or crossing tower), turret (small tower in a re-entrant corner, stair turret), gate (front range of a closed ring carrying the gate hall), part (base template or axis-locked composer part), shelter (cluster structure), tier (stepped stage, tier k >= 1 on tier k - 1), shrine (small roofed range on a stepped top), stair (solid flight climbing a tier's face).

V02-0092.statement: MassingFamilyId = single, L, T, H, U, cross, plotRing, towerHouse (historical plan types); regularCourt, starCourt, chordArc, rectCourt, gridWalk (our ids for FM's five layout families, item 59; renamed from PathShapeRow ids by BCR-V2-06's migration row, J-V2.47); row; template, axisLocked, baseOutline (base constructions for institutions, MFCG/FTG presets, last fallback); shelter, drawn; stepped; ovalCourt (elliptical two-ring court, arcaded façade ring and solid seating ring round an open floor; not fantasy).

V02-0093.statement: BaseWing gains role (persisted; written by massing, mutator convert step, setMassing; read by composer, mutator match, roofscape joint priority, exports, anchors), key (stable ordinal written once when minted, never changed, never re-used after removal), arcade? (open ground-storey arcade written by M11 from the row's arcade cell and setAttr(wings/<key>/arcade); read by drawing dashed outline, exports open, §2.6 capacity no ground rooms). Building gains nextWingKey (next free key; = wing count at S11; never decreases) and massing? MassingRef (absent only on an un-upgraded pre-stage-3 document).

V02-0094.statement: MassingRef: family; row (the CompositionRow key reached: template composition value, <class>/<band>, <family>/<band>, default.<arrangement>/<band>, with @underground on the underground layer); grammar (composition.json version read); entrance {wing key, side} or null (entrance hint, BCR-V2-23; null for row, shelter, drawn footprint); segments (path segment count after collinear merging, before M7 splits; FM's count unit; 1 for single, row, towerHouse and base constructions; written by M5, every setMassing op and the mutator; read by parity harness, report, why provider); low? {wing, end 0 or 1} (axis fallLine only: main range's downhill end, V03's byre end; rewritten on reshape); cupola? {kind dome/tip/pyramid, wing} (M12 ornament, drawn and exported, never in Heights, never a caster; dropped when its wing leaves, kept at new midpoint on reshape).

V02-0095.statement: DriftBounds (typed once here): areaPct band around the row's target (default [-15, 15]); floors relative to the row's draw (default [-1, 1]); families? (absent: the row's; before stage 3 registers only baseOutline, template, axisLocked, row, shelter and stepped admitted, any other ignored and reported driftFamilyIgnored, read once stage 3 registers); roofKinds?; classFamily? (§6.3's building class family the assignment keeps).

V02-0096.statement: BaseWing.partName (V03's BCR-V3-13): template part name (nave, transept, crossing, chancel, apse, tower, cloister walk ...) written by base outline builder templates; V02 mints none; M0 (d) passes it through; every V02 wing writer (mutator W-steps, setMassing ops and bends, canonical re-keying, rebaseStack) keeps it on the wing keeping its key (re-joined block pieces keep the lowest key piece's partName); a wing V02 adds carries none; read by M8 (e) (crossing tower over part crossing), cryptSeedWings, V03 A5 (e); lifecycle row V03's (V03 §2.5; S23-15).

V02-0097.statement: RoofSpec gains kind 'shed' (single-pitch) and high? (ring side along which a shed roof stands at ridge height, the side against the host wall; absent on other kinds); a shed wing's ridgeCm is its height at high, eaveCm on the opposite side; written by the massing (M12) and setAttr(wings/<key>/roof).

V02-0098.statement: Canonical wing order (stated once; J-V2.48): Building.wings is always towers and turrets first ascending by key, then every other wing ascending by key; the massing mints keys in that order (M13); every writer (mutator, setMassing, migration row) re-sorts before commit, so §2.6's clip order (towers first) and every derived order are functions of the keys; a tower standing on a block is contained in its block and clipped after its container by §2.6's containment rule.

V02-0099.statement: Wings named by key, never position: under stage 3 Entrance.wing, Porch (via its wing), Room.wing, StairCore.wing, StairCore.tower (key of the tower wing whose round room holds the spiral), Chimney.wing, Storey.wings[], ProgramRoom.wing hold base wing keys; a tower's room names its tower wing's key (no wings.length + offset); a composed wing found by its base key; the base's index reading stays for the base outline builder (keys = indices); adding or removing a wing never re-points a stored door, room, stair or chimney (T-V2-34).

V02-0100.statement: Composed Wing gains base (key of the base wing it composes; 1:1 with non-tower non-turret base wings) and dormerRows (0-2 rows, one per eave side); footprint, heights, roof, spans derived from the named base wing whenever base is set (never stored then); dormers count derived as sum of rows' counts; porch only on the main-entrance wing whose role admits one (WingRoleRow.porch). The composition never re-shapes the massing (J-V2.2, J-V2.6).

V02-0101.statement: DormerRow {eave 0 or 1 (first eave side in ring order is 0), count >= 0 (positions derived by dormerPositions, never stored), widthCm, kind, edited? (set by setComposition: fixed input to the plan rung's step 6, kept through a wings-rung re-derivation while the eave keeps its length within ± 10 %)}; DormerKind = dormer (set back from eave), wallGable (gablet breaking the eave), hoist (warehouse loading dormer), entranceGable (gable over the main entrance bay); PorchKind = hood, gabled, twoStorey, recessed, halfRound (half-disc under a half-cone roof, FM's commonest; weight 0 by default, calibrated under FM); Porch gains kind (side and offset stay the main entrance's, base rule 3).

V02-0102.statement: ComposedTower gains base (key of the massing's tower or turret wing; its ring is that wing's; centre = ring area centroid, radiusCm = largest vertex distance rounded up, heights and roof read from the wing, never stored when base set). Composition gains row, grammar, secondaryPorch? {entrance ordinal (side, rear or yard entrance), widthCm, depthCm} (a hood only, J-V2.44; lazy, stored when an edit stores it; side and offset re-read after every carry); courts derived at read (holes of the footprint face in ring order), never stored.

V02-0103.statement: A stored composition stores only row, grammar, per composed wing its base and dormer rows, the porch, per composed tower its base, and the rooms and plan the base defines; its world points are only the rooms' and plan's, which carryWings carries (J-P48); composed wings and towers follow their base wings, so a stored composition adds no carried ring (J-V2.6).

V02-0104.statement: composition.json: one versioned table file in @plat/tables read through the override layer (§7.6); every cell {value, unit, provenance, calibratable, extension?, presets?}; every calibratable cell has a calibration register entry (V12 §3.11: default, confirming measurement, due milestone, fallback) written by the seat landing its milestone (M3a-V2, M6a, M6b, M6c), plat calibrate register --check green at that exit; a presets.FM measured-rate entry set only by V12's reference run; code-read FM entries (rich rows' families, sunBias 0.5) carry ref:... (code) provenance and move by no run; sunBias's parity-neutral entries under zeroing presets MFCG, FTG, VG (0.5 where zeroing gives 0) are own with note 'fixed: the parity neutral' (V11 §2.2 rule (a)); each column family's metric, method, due and fallback are V2 §3.10.10's line. Readers S11, composer, mutator, roofscape, §8.10. Slice kinds row (CompositionRow, WingRoleRow, MassingGrowthRow), weights (families, porch, tower-shape), bracket (TowerShapeRow.sides).

V02-0105.statement: CompositionRow (one per key and band, compiled from four authored anchors; continuous cells interpolate along prosperity between band centres, discrete cells switch at the cut, item 19): key <prefix>/<band> (template-family key, class id override, structure-role key, default.<arrangement>, outbuilding; @underground suffixed rows per prefix); prefix; band; alias?; families [{family, weight}] (continuous; renormalised over feasible set; must satisfy the arrangement law); axis frontage/fallLine/water (discrete, default frontage); wingWidthM; rangeLenM; crossWing {fwdM, backM}; courtMinM; uOpenFront; blocks; blockStoreyDelta; towers (a towerHouse's own tower not counted); towerShape {round, square, octagon}; towerRadiusW; towerStoreyDelta; towerOnBlock (0 default, calibrated under FM); towerFlat; westTowers (discrete: cathedral 2 at west corners, church 0-1); crossingTower; gateTower; turret; backRange; backLenM; backWidthM; hipShare; gableToStreetMaxFrontM; arcade (discrete); cupola {chance, kinds}; dormer {perTenM, widthM, kinds, entranceGable}; porch weights incl. none; secondaryPorch (0 default, calibrated under FM); rooms {hall (discrete), hallLenShare, chapel, gateHallM} read at the occupants' band; floors? (role row's own storey range); hearths; coverageMax; claimShare? (M10 band = claimShare x area(H); absent on a claim-sized template -> constants claimLo/claimHi 0.35, 0.6); caveaM? (ovalCourt seating ring depth).

V02-0106.statement: MassingFamilyRow (supersedes PathShapeRow; FM's five families keep their rows (P21) under our ids): family, minFrameW (least frame in wing widths), wings (range of ranges before blocks split; M13 checks), closed, joints butt/mitre/either (M13 checks), fantasy (true for regularCourt, starCourt, chordArc; weight scaled by fantasyShapes; D-7), sides?/sideWeights? (regularCourt side counts; starCourt corner counts), chords? (chordArc), gridCells? (gridWalk), provenance.

V02-0107.statement: WingRoleRow {role, storeyDelta, roofKinds [{kind, weight}], hipInset (ridge-end inset share of span, 0.5 equal pitches; ranges 0.5, blocks 0.5 default and 0.25 under FM), through (priority at a butt joint), dormers, porch}; MassingGrowthRow {from, to, keep all/main/mainAndOne/none, anchor front/rear/either} (mutator's family lattice); TowerShapeRow {shape round/square/octagon, sides bracket [{maxRadiusM, n}], roof cone/pyramid, pitch (rise over radius)}; PorchKindRow {kind, depthM, widthM, storeys, clearanceM (kept free in front), outside (false: recessed)}; DormerKindRow {kind, depthShare, atEave, minPitch, gapM} (end margin = constants endMarginM read by facadeBays).

V02-0108.statement: RoleKeyRow (composition.roleKeys): family (V11 template-family key or '*'; family-specific row wins), name (V11 §3.6.1 structure name, e.g. stable, stables, nave and choir, wheel or sails), key (composition key prefix, or yardPart: not a building, or basement: held in the cellar), attach slot (S11 packs its own slot) or main (main slot's massing lays it, BCR-V2-29; M8b). ClassFamilyRow {cls (V07 village class v.<id>), key} (composition.classFamily, one source of their keys, J-V7.82; scope withdrawn, J-V2.96). HeightsRow is V11's (V11 §2.8 heights keyed by template family) read unchanged with BCR-V2-26's attic, parapetCm, towerStoreyCm? whose values V11 §3.6.4 writes once (SCC-20); V02 declares no heights row (J-V2.33). CompositionConstantsRow {key constants, cells}; CompositionTables {rows, families, roles, growth, towers, porches, dormers, roleKeys, classFamily, constants, version}.

V02-0109.statement: Derived at read: RoofEnd = gable, hip, party, mitre, valley, wall, open (per wing end from joints and heights); RoofFacet {wing key, ring, z (cm above building's lowest base per vertex), normal, part roof/dormer/porch/tower/cupola}; roofscape(b, c?): RoofFacet[] (planar, non-overlapping, covering the footprint and a porch outside it); resolveEnds(b): Map<wing key, [RoofEnd, RoofEnd]>; facadeBays(w, side, bayM): {atCm, widthCm}[] (every ring side; integer cm only; valley reaches by §6.5 arithmetic never the float roofscape; implemented in @plat/plots beside massStepped, stairTreads, cryptSeedWings, re-exported by @plat/buildings); dormerPositions(w, row, obstacles); cryptSeedWings(b): wing keys whose ground storeys seed a crypt's ring (called by §2.6's basement function).

V02-0110.statement: Eave sides: a wing's two eave sides are the ring sides parallel to its ridge (ridgeAxis 0: sides 2 and 4; ridgeAxis 1: sides 1 and 3); eave 0 comes first in ring order; a polygon wing has no eave sides (no dormers).

V02-0111.statement: BaseWing.role: create massing S11, mutator add step, setMassing (addRange, addTower, addBlock, backRange); read composer, mutator, roofscape, exports, anchors; persist leaf digest; regenerate Regenerate keep re-derives the same, New random on the plot re-draws with the plot's reroll (§6.1); undo record keeps former wings; migrate base carries it from M1 (BCR-V2-01: base outline builder writes main, range or part), else the fallback migration row. BaseWing.key, nextWingKey: as role; new key = nextWingKey which advances; generation keys 0..n-1 in wing order (M13); undo restores nextWingKey.

V02-0112.statement: Building.massing: create S11 massing, setMassing family, mutator (target family and row); read mutator, deriveEntrances, exports, reader; persist leaf digest; undo restored; migrate an older document keeps its value, one before stage 3 has none and reads as baseOutline until an upgrade re-derives S11 (§7.5; declared shift §13.3). MassingRef.segments, .low, .cupola: create M5, M12, every setMassing op and the mutator; read parity harness, report, why (segments), V03 byre (low), roofscape, paint programs, exports (cupola); regenerate with the massing (same draws); migrate absent -> segments = range-role wing count with block pieces re-joined, low and cupola absent until upgrade.

V02-0113.statement: Crypt lift (ground-storey baseCm of ground wings over the basement's ring, raised form) and half cellar's raise (ground wings over a half basement's ring by cellar.depthCm / 2; for a crypt-only basement the wings over the crypt's ring; BCR-V2-28): create M11 when §2.6's basement function takes the crypt ladder's raised form, basement step when the gate chooses half (gate reads the datum without the raise); read deriveBase's successors, heights, V03 floor levels (choir stairs, 3.3 datum), dig floor, roofscape, casters; persist leaf digest (those wings' Heights.baseCm); regenerate with the basement after setMassing, a mutation or a terrain change, kept by deriveBase and rebaseStack (1) on every re-basing path while half (T-V2-52); undo with wings; migrate: an always-crypt building without it re-derives the basement on load (V03 migrate row, BCR-V3-20); half basements lacking the raise gain it at next upgrade (one-time shift J-V2.91, reported).

V02-0114.statement: BaseWing.partName: create base templates passed through by M0 (d); read M8 (e), cryptSeedWings, V03 A5 (e), why; persist leaf digest; regenerate kept on the key-keeping wing by every V02 writer, absent on V02-added wings; undo with wings; migrate V03's row. RoofSpec shed and high: create M12, setAttr; read roofscape, exports; migrate none before stage 3. BaseWing.arcade: create M11 (row arcade), setAttr(wings/<key>/arcade); read drawing, exports, capacity; regenerate with massing; migrate absent before stage 3.

V02-0115.statement: Composition.secondaryPorch: create composer, setComposition porch with entrance; read roofscape, drawing, exports; persist lazy, stored with the composition; regenerate as the porch; undo restored; migrate by entrance ordinal, a missing entrance orphans it (§7.3 item 4), reported. Composition.row, .grammar: create composer; read elaboration record slices, migration; persist lazy, stored when an edit stores it; regenerate stale rung re-derives from committed state; migrate an older-grammar stored composition keeps stored fields, unstored parts re-derive under the new grammar at next click. Wing.base: 1:1 with non-tower base wings; stored one re-matched by key when wings change; a missing key orphans the composed wing, reported.

V02-0116.statement: Wing.dormerRows, DormerRow.edited: create composer, setComposition dormers (sets edited); read roofscape, plan rung, exports; persist lazy, stored at the first setComposition; regenerate unedited row re-derives on the wing's own stream, edited row kept while its eave length stays within ± 10 % else orphaned and reported; undo keeps the former row; migrate by wing key. Porch.kind: create composer, setComposition porch; regenerate as dormer rows, side and offset re-read from the main entrance after every carry (rule 3). ComposedTower.base: one per tower or turret wing, follows the tower wing, migrate by key. Composition as a whole: create wings rung (and rooms with the plan); read §8.6, plan rung; persist elaboration cache (non-canonical §2.9), model data once stored; regenerate stale -> re-derived at next click; undo restores former composition or removes it when that edit stored it (J-P48 (5)); migrate §7.5 orphan rule.

V02-0117.statement: Fallback migration row (document with no stage-3 fields, from before BCR-V2-01 reached M1): key = index in Building.wings; role by the base outline builder's rule (main for the first rectangle or a row quad, range for other rectangles, part for template or axis-locked part); nextWingKey = wing count; massing absent (read as baseOutline with segments 1 until an upgrade re-derives S11, declared shift §13.3); footprints, heights, roofs unchanged; canonical order holds (base builder lays no tower); BCR-V2-27's index-named fields need no rewrite (key = index).

V02-0118.statement: A base wing's address = its building's with its key, sub-record address ('wing', building, key), matched after re-derivation by BCR-V2-11's anchor rule (role, then ridge midpoint within 0.5 m in the building's frame); composed wing, dormer rows and composed tower addressed through the base wing key; porch by the building; composer's rooms by the base's room:<building>/<level>/<i> (§2.6, §6.3); no record stores a stream key or seed.

V02-0119.statement: Item 110 adds no entity kind: tier, shrine and stair are base wings (sub-records of Building) with fields saying what they stand on and whether solid; a deck building is an ordinary building whose BuildingInput names its deck.

V02-0120.statement: BaseWing gains on? (key of the wing it stands on; floor = that wing's deckLevel; tier k >= 1 names tier k-1, shrine the top tier, stair k >= 1 the tier on whose terrace its foot stands; absent = on the ground, every family but stepped; written by massing ST7, tiers op, mutator's stepped rows, never re-pointed otherwise; read by deriveBase BCR-V2-32, storeyRange, capacity BCR-V2-33, roofscape occlusion and order, carry check BCR-V2-35, exports, V03 X18) and solid? (solid mass, no interior: stepped pyramid rubble tier, every stair: Heights.floors 0, eaveCm its top above baseCm, no storey, room, dormer, porch or capacity; written by ST4, ST5, the ovalCourt seating ring M5, tiers op, mutator (cleared when stepped -> single keeps a solid tier 0 as a storeyed range); read by storeyRange, capacity, M11, composer, V03, exports).

V02-0121.statement: MassingRef.stack? (present exactly when family stepped): shape rect/round/octagon; stairs axial/flights/internal/none (form laid after ST3 fallback; none = sealed stack, lawful only where tier 0 is solid, never a row value, reached only by an edit's bend); lowerRoof flat/pent; top flat/shrine/roofed; insetCm (drawn step d re-used by tiers op); grade (drawn stair rise/run re-used by tiers op); truncated (tiers drawn but not laid, reported).

V02-0122.statement: TierCells (on a row whose families include stepped): count [>= 2 incl. top] drawn uniformly; shape weights rect/round/octagon; aspect (clamp of rect tier 0 width/depth, the laid aspect the drawn stack's own proportion clamped, never drawn, J-V2.86); insetM (step); solid all/lower/none; solidHeightM (tier k x taper^k); tierFloors (tier k x taper^k rounded stochastically, >= 1); taper; lowerRoof flat (walkable terrace with family parapetCm) or pent (skirt rising to the tier above); top weights flat/shrine/roofed; shrine {floors, insetShare, roofs}; stairs axial/flights/internal (none never a row value); stairWidthM; stairGrade range (upper end at most stairGradeMax 1.3); heights? {storeyGroundCm, storeyUpperCm} read only where no HeightsRow passed (V04's ruin), only for a shrine's storeys (stepped-monument 350/300).

V02-0123.statement: Construction contract (J-V2.80), all exported by @plat/plots: massStepped(input, row, band, k) -> KernelResult<{wings, massing}> (the stepped branch: frontage frame steps 1-2, slotBand, ST0, drawTiers on massing creation indices 8-9, layTiers, ST8, M14's attempts on massing/attempt=a with drawTiers re-run, then single fallback ST8, then the base outline rectangle; called by the base outline builder from M3a (BCR-V2-39), stage 3's M5 from M6a; T-V2-46 compares; V04 never calls it); slotBand(input, row, band) -> {lo, hi, cap} m² (one formula for M3, ST0, ST8, M10); massOval(input, row, band, k) (ovalCourt branch M3, M5, M11-M13, same bytes from base builder M3a and stage 3 M6a); drawTiers(cells, storeys, s8, s9) -> TierDraws (ST1); layTiers(input) -> TierLay or TierFailure (ST2-ST7, pure: no draw, budget, stream); BandRead {band, value (manifested, significance-shifted)}.

V02-0124.statement: TierInput {frame {origin, u along frontage, v inward, origin Rr's near front corner}, region {W, D} (fit rectangle Rr), scale (ST8 size factor, 1 at first lay), cells, storeys {groundCm, upperCm} (HeightsRow storeyCm or TierCells.heights for V04), pitch, parapetCm, plinthCm (ruin passes 0 and 0), draws, anchor? (tier 0 ring given: four corners of a kept range or a regular ring), forms? (stair forms to try in order)}; TierDraws {n, shape, insetCm, top, stairWidthCm, grade, tiers [{heightCm without parapet, floors (0 solid)}], shrine?}; LaidWing {ring, kind rect/polygon, role tier/shrine/stair, on index or null, solid, floors, eaveCm, ridgeCm, roof}; TierLay {wings (ST7 order), stairs laid, aspect, truncated, entrance hint by index}; TierFailure {kind noSecondTier/check, step ST3/ST6, detail}.

V02-0125.statement: DeckContext (BuildingInput.deck, written by S11 from the plot's deck record, absent elsewhere): host (Bridge or pier/quay way), kind bridge/pier/mole/quay (jetty is a pier; a raised way's deck carries no plot, J-V2.71), surfaceCm (Bridge.deckCm or pier's, mole's, quay's deck height §4.8, read by the datum step; null exactly for a quay platform built on the bank: that is ground (terrain datum, ordinary basement gate, dig floor) while kind quay keeps the @deck rows and deck budget; a ford or draw Bridge or one with no deckCm offers no deck plot (X28)), landmark (placed landmark: its class's own rows, no deck budget; copied by S11 from the deck-plot record's landmark flag (X28, the coherence pass)). DeckBudgetRead {footprintM2, maxFloors} from V11's deck table (kind x band; X16); V02 declares no row.

V02-0126.statement: Derived (exported by @plat/plots, built at M3a-V2): deckLevel(w) = w.baseCm + w.eaveCm less the family's parapetCm when w's roof is flat (exact since ST4 adds the parapet to every flat-roofed tier's eave); rebaseStack(b, ground) (J-V2.81): (1) ground wings by §2.6's terrain rule as BCR-V2-32 words it, every sample by ground (deck surface, kept user base, BCR-V2-42 wall-side sample, crypt lift, half raise); (2) every wing with on in stack order, baseCm = deckLevel of its support; (3) every stair's ridgeCm re-set to its true rise and stairSteep re-tested; (4) Building.heights by the envelope rule incl. floors; every re-basing path of such a building calls it instead of the per-wing step, passing ground = levelledGroundCm(doc, key, ·) on its own document and the plot's arena key (S23R3-17), never the raster sampler.

V02-0127.statement: storeyRange(b, w): null for a solid wing; [0, floors-1] storeyed on the ground; for a storeyed wing with on: [t, t+floors-1], t = next(on), next(x) = storeyRange(b,x)[1]+1 for storeyed x, next(x.on) for solid x with on, 0 for solid x on the ground (shrine on a solid pyramid is storey 0; tier above a two-storey tier 0 starts at storey 2); towers, turrets and other wings the base's reading. stairChain(b): per stair wing in key order {stair, from (terrace wing or null ground), to, head ring side (RoofSpec.high)}; empty for internal and none forms and other families. landingSide(b, w): for a storeyed wing with on, the ring side nearest the head of the stair arriving on its terrace (axial front side; flights the last flight's head side); null for internal and none; where V03 opens its landing door (X18) and on a solid stack roots the plan (BCR-V2-41).

V02-0128.statement: stairTreads(w) (J-V2.90; J-S23.6): the one tread law of a stair wing: n = ceil(rise / riserMaxCm) equal risers (rise = w.ridgeCm, true rise kept by rebaseStack (3); riserMaxCm 20 cm), goingCm = floor(run / n) (run = plan distance from the side opposite RoofSpec.high to high) by §6.5 integer arithmetic; k-th riser top at floor(k x rise / n), head tread takes run's remainder (run - n x goingCm); read by stairFlight (n - 1 tread lines), glTF/OBJ/CityJSON stair solids, V01 stair-flight hatch, V03 exterior flights (its own goingCm stays for interior stairs); rise 0 -> n = 0, no treads (a ramp).

V02-0129.statement: BaseWing.on: create ST7, tiers op, W6 (stepped -> stepped); persist leaf digest; regenerate re-derived with the massing by the same draws, a tiers edit's result a fixed input of later S11 runs (base pin of edited wings); undo with wings; migrate absent before the fold: every wing on the ground, byte-identical (T-V2-50). BaseWing.solid: create ST4, ST5, tiers op solid field, cleared by stepped -> single, ovalCourt seating ring M5; as on; migrate absent -> storeyed. MassingRef.stack: create ST7 via massStepped, rewritten by every tiers op, bend and stepped mutation; read tiers op, why, exports; regenerate as the massing, a tiers edit's stack a fixed input; undo with Building.massing; migrate: stack migration row re-derives a missing stack or grade at load from wings (shape from tier 0 kind and vertex count 4 rect, 8 octagon, else round; stairs axial when stair 0 centred on tier 0's centre line, flights when along tier 0's face, none with tier 0 storeyed -> internal, none with tier 0 solid -> none; lowerRoof from tier 1's roof; top from the top wing; insetCm least ring offset of tier 1 in tier 0; grade stair 0 rise/run (none: row central grade); truncated 0), one-time shift reported.

V02-0130.statement: tiers op fields (count, insetCm, top, stairs, stairWidthCm, shape, lowerRoof, solid, shrineInsetShare, centre, radiusCm): event log, wings and stack model data; regenerate as V2 §4.4's setMassing row; undo the former wings and stack; migrate by address and wing keys. Works heights of a stack: heightsAt in stack order (BCR-V2-40), derived never stored, read §8.4, §11.1, V06. ovalCourt wings: as any wing; migrate none (arena row grammar bump a declared shift for arenas only). BuildingInput.deck: S11 per call, never stored, re-read every S11 run. Stacked wing baseCm, stair ridgeCm, stack envelope (Building.heights incl. floors): rebaseStack on every re-basing path (S11, setMassing commit, tier height edit, §7.3 (a) 4 terrain operator, §7.4 warp and moveVertex, carry rule (2), crypt lift, deck re-base); a setAttr of a stacked wing's baseCm bends to its support's height; a deck building's baseCm by the datum step from DeckContext.surfaceCm, re-derived when the deck height changes.

V02-0131.statement: WingRoleRow defaults for new roles (J V2C-65): tier: storeys from TierCells, through 6 (tier 0 runs through at stair 0's butt joint), dormers no, porch yes (storeyed tier 0's main door), hipInset .5, roofKinds flat 1, hip 1, pyramid 1, cone 1 (ST4 picks; W5's first allowed kind flat); shrine: storeys from TierCells.shrine, through 0, dormers no, porch no, roofKinds TierCells.shrine.roofs (default hip 1, pyramid 1, gable 1); stair: floors 0, roofKinds shed 1, through 0, dormers no, porch no.

V02-0132.statement: Where stage 3 runs: massing outline() at S11 once per building in the block's batch and inside every operator re-deriving S11 on a plot (Regenerate, New random, mutation add step, build, fill, terrain or water re-fit §7.3), derivation pool or generation worker, eager model data, output Building.wings with roles and keys, massing, nextWingKey then S11's base steps (insertion and first carry, deriveBase, deriveEntrances, basement decision, yard partition, households fill), stream massing; setMassing commit at the event's fold, eager, edited wings as S11 fixed input then S11 base steps, no stream for geometric ops, family op on siteplan.mutate; composer compose(..., wings) on the wings rung (neighbourhood click, building click when wings absent or stale, visible tile at neighbourhood band or finer under elaborate view (district band draws the massing's roofscape, needs no composition), an export asking for compositions), derivation pool, lazy, streams compose.dormers, compose.porch; rooms rung only as the plan rung's input on the plan-deriving building click (J-V2.9), stream compose.rooms; roofscape at every draw at district band and finer, surface layer, 3-D exports, derived at read, no draws; mutator's wing step at every designation change (§4.7 S11 steps 1-7), eager, siteplan.mutate.

V02-0133.statement: Registration: @plat/buildings registers ComposedBuildingGenerator as composed in StrategyRegistry.building (§14); from stage 3's landing the recipe's building strategy defaults to composed for new documents; a document keeps its recipe's strategy (§7.5); plan() delegates to V03's registered plan implementation. Under MFCG and FTG the massing takes family baseOutline for every class: option cell massing.composed (extension {over both, mode option}, on by default) is off there, so parity presets keep the base outline footprints byte for byte (T-V2-26) and §13.5's MFCG and FTG rows are unaffected.

V02-0134.statement: Class (step 1): S10b's class-mix draw (item 71) or the assignment's shapeClass; slot role from the slot's structure (§4.7 S11); a clandestine front reads the front's row (item 63 (4)), the concealed use adds nothing to massing or composition. Owner rules: split sites (item 105 (h)) branchOf use composes as split.shop, works building as split.works (V11 §2.3); ladders (item 108) COUNT, QUARTER, GUILD members ordinary buildings of LadderStepRow.memberClass, GUILD hall composes as hall family, SIZE building as the greater class with sizeFactor in M10; custom institutions (item 104) the DR24-resolved class (V11 §3.13.2); subsumption (item 104 (h)(5), 108) extra slots.

V02-0135.statement: Row key resolution chain (stated once; J-V2.34): stops at the first key whose row exists and satisfies the arrangement law for the compiled template's arrangement at this band (V2 §3.10.7); a row breaking the law is skipped and reported at load (arrangementSkip, T-V2-33). Main slot: (1) DesignationTemplateRow.composition; (2) <class>/<band> override; (3) for a v. class composition.classFamily[v. key] (a town class at a village rung plays its villageForm's v. class, V11 §3.22); (4) <templateFamily>/<band> via BuildingClassRow.templateFamily (V11 must read 'read by S11's composition resolution (V02)'); (5) default.<arrangement>/<band>. Other slots: structures[i].composition; <key>/<band> with key = composition.roleKeys[(templateFamily, name)] else [('*', name)]; outbuilding/<band>. yardPart or basement role keys have no building; attach main laid by the main slot's massing (M8b). Underground: @underground appended (<prefix>@underground/<band> else default.underground/<band>), via BuildingInput.layer. Decks: @deck appended for a non-landmark deck plot (<key>@deck/<band> else default.<arrangement>@deck/<band>); a landmark reads its class chain; a deck plot is never underground. Key reached written to MassingRef.row and Composition.row.

V02-0136.statement: Band (step 3): every geometry cell read at the plot's manifested band and value (§4.11 floor rule max(field band, geometryFloor)); continuous cells interpolate between band centres along the value (§4.5), discrete switch at the cut (item 19; J-A19.43); the district's band range (item 72, §4.5 (5)) clamps the value first; rooms cells are read at the occupants' band (fieldBand and current field value; item 28 (f); J-V2.36). Significance: for every geometry cell and M10's budget the value shifts by 0.5 x bandWidth x log2(σ_use / σ_class) before interpolation (σ_use incl. V11 §3.13's x2 landmark and economicWeight 0.5-2), clamped to at most one band up and never below the plot's own value (J-V2.43; T-V2-38).

V02-0137.statement: Scale and drift (step 4): every length cell x the district's buildingScale (§2.5); DriftBounds filters families and roof kinds and clamps footprint target and floors. Presets (step 5): the document's preset resolves each cell by §7.6's order; building-scope FM (BCR-V2-14) resolves only cells carrying a presets.FM entry (composition.json's V2 §3.10.8 and V11 §3.24.0's item-110 chance and offer cells, 0) and sets fantasyShapes on; zeroes no extension cell, changes nothing else.

V02-0138.statement: Massing families (historical type; construction; joints; wings; closed; source): single (hovel, cottage, open-hall house, warehouse, chapel nave; one range along the frontage or gable to street when narrow; 1; no; own); L (street range with a range behind; front range through, side range abutting; butt; 2); T (hall with one cross-wing through the hall's end; butt; 2); H (hall with two cross-wings; butt; 3); U (three ranges round a yard open to rear or front; butt; 3); cross (main range crossed at its middle; NG C2; WingRoleRow.through decides; butt; 2 (3 pieces)); rectCourt (courtyard house, inn, college; four ranges, front range gate; butt; 4; closed; FM rectangle family P21); plotRing (urban courtyard house following an irregular plot; 4-8 ranges along boundary inset by half a wing; mitre; closed; own); gridWalk (accreted house; self-avoiding grid walk; butt; 1-8; FM grid-walk P21); towerHouse (tower house, tower mill, bottle kiln, polygonal chapter house; tower mass at a front corner with optional range; butt/overlap; 1-2 + tower); regularCourt (regular 4-, 5-, 6-, 8-gon ring; mitre; closed; FM regular, fantasy); starCourt (4-6 corners at jittered radii; mitre; closed; FM irregular closed, fantasy); chordArc (first chords of a regular polygon, convex to street; mitre; 2-7; FM open-chain, fantasy); row (row arrangement's quads unchanged plus optional back range; base); template, axisLocked, baseOutline (base constructions plus M8 (e) west and crossing towers and M8b attached; base); shelter (cluster structure; base item 70); drawn (rect if near-rectangle else polygon with skeleton roof; base §7.1); stepped (stepped temple, ziggurat, terraced palace, tiered tower, ruin's stepped monument; massStepped/layTiers; tier 0 and stair 0 butt; 2-9 tiers; item 110 (c)); ovalCourt (amphitheatre: two concentric rings of mitred quad slabs on an elliptical chord polygon, outer storeyed façade ring and inner solid seating ring sharing vertices, hole the floor; mitre; 24-40 (two rings of 12-20); closed; own, not fantasy J-V2.84).

V02-0139.statement: Our ids for the reference's families (J-V2.47): regularCourt, starCourt, chordArc, rectCourt, gridWalk are our names; item-59 PathShapeRow ids map through BCR-V2-06's table-migration row applied before M6 ships any document, so no reference routine name survives in a table, export or document. Fantasy shapes are a toggle (J-V2.5): the three fantasy families carry weights in manor, hall, tower, mage_tower rows multiplied by the model option fantasyShapes (recipe parameter with its §7.8 control row, BCR-V2-30; off by default, D-7); off never drawn; on at row weights; FM sets it on with FM's equal weights.

V02-0140.statement: Fitting: the massing works inside the slot hint H (SlotPlan.hint §2.5: behind the front-line recession item 43 and template setbacks, inside the plot, clear of other slots); nothing leaves H (T-V2-1). (1) frontage direction f = unit direction of the longest access segment among those the slot's entranceOn names (ties by segment index; length by sqrt only); n = f turned toward H's area centroid; frame (u along f, v along n) origin at the access segment's first end (§6.5 ops). (2) fit rectangle Rr = lir(H, (f, n)) width W along u, depth D along v, front nearest the access segment; rectilinear families inside Rr; plotRing follows H; fantasy families in the ellipse inscribed in Rr. (3) wing width w drawn in wingWidthM clamped w <= D, w <= W, w <= (min(W,D) - courtMinM)/2 for closed; infeasible when clamped w < max(0.8 x wingWidthM[0], 3 m). (4) orientation the frontage's (item 59 KEEP OURS); fantasy phase puts one side parallel and nearest; axis fallLine (longhouse down the slope, byre downhill; V07 hard rule) and water (mill or landing long side parallel to the water) replace it (J-V2.41). (5) rows arrive as fixedWings; only the back range is laid (M9) in the back region: plot ∩ band behind the quad's rear chain of depth max(0, coverage x plotArea / frontage - rowDepth), clipped to H.

V02-0141.statement: outline(input, k) is the add step of V2 §3.9 from the empty design (base 'one path', §4.7 S11 step 7): generation and later mutation lay wings with the same functions; inputs BuildingInput (slot hint, access segments, context vector, class, drift, fixedWings for a row or cluster structure, terrain sampler, resolved row key and bands, layer and attached structures BCR-V2-24, -29); output KernelResult<{wings}> plus the MassingRef S11 writes; constants in the row or constants table (V2 §3.10.9); every draw on the massing stream with the step's creation index.

V02-0142.statement: M0 pass-throughs: (a) row fixedWings (one quad or stepped quads on a slope) returned unchanged with role main and keys in order; M9 may add a back range; M11-M12 heights and roofs; entrance hint null (base rule 1: door on the flush front); segments 1. (b) shelter: one fixed wing (BCR-V2-24) role shelter; roof tent for a tent (polygon), shed for a lean-to with high on the host-wall side, gable or shed for a shack by row weights. (c) drawn: V2 §3.3's drawn row. (d) institutions: template or axisLocked runs the base construction (§2.6), parts labelled part (a template tower part takes tower); M8 (e) west and crossing towers; M8b attached structures (church porch). (e) baseOutline: base rectangle, L or T, roles main and range. (f) underground: @underground row lays single with flat roof and nothing more (V04, V05 own vaults).

V02-0143.statement: M2 frame by axis (J-V2.41): frontage (default: V2 §3.4 steps 1-2); fallLine: terrain gradient at H's centroid (central differences at ± axisSampleM 2 m, base sampler §2.3) gives slope s and downhill direction g; where s > axisSlope (3 %; own; V07 longhouse) frame u = g, v = g turned toward the access side, Rr = lir(H,(u,v)), front nearest the access; main range laid along u (single the along mode whatever the frontage), its downhill ridge end (larger u) written to MassingRef.low; else frontage frame. water: nearest water-face edge (§2.7 water bodies, carved channels incl. a mill leat) within axisWaterM (50 m; own) of H's centroid gives u along it, v away from water, water side = Rr side nearest the edge, main range's long side on the water side; none within reach -> frontage frame. In both non-frontage frames the entrance hint is the main range's long side nearer the access kept by entranceHintMinCos (access-less side null, base rule decides).

V02-0144.statement: M3 feasibility per family with weight > 0 (after fantasyShapes, drift families, massing.composed), w0 = max(0.8 x wingWidthM[0], 3 m): (1) geometry W >= minFrameW[0] x w0 and D >= minFrameW[1] x w0, closed families W - 2w0 >= courtMinM and D - 2w0 >= courtMinM; default minFrameW (along x into): single 1.2 x 1, L 2 x 2, T 2.4 x 2, H 3.4 x 2, U 3 x 2.2, cross 3 x 3, rectCourt 3 x 3, plotRing 3 x 3, gridWalk 2.6 x 2.6, towerHouse 1.2 x 1.2, regularCourt and starCourt 3.2 x 3.2, chordArc 2.6 x 1.6, stepped ST0's test, ovalCourt: c0 = caveaM[0], c = courtMinM, b0 = w0 + c0 + c/2, a0 = 1.15 x b0, feasible when Rr's longer side >= 2a0 and shorter >= 2b0.

V02-0145.statement: M3 budget (J-V2.35): least footprint Amin at w0, least lengths and courtMinM (f0 = crossWing.fwdM[0], b0 = crossWing.backM[0], c = courtMinM, gap0 = max(walkGapM, 0.3 w0)): single 1.2w0²; L 3w0²; T 2.4w0² + w0(f0 + b0); H 3.4w0² + 2w0(f0 + b0); U 5w0²; cross 5w0²; rectCourt S² - (S - 2w0)² with S = max(2w0 + c, 3w0); plotRing (c + 2w0)² - c²; gridWalk w0(w0 + gap0); towerHouse 1.44w0² plus w0 x max(1.5w0, rangeLenM[0]) where rangeLenM[0] > 0; regularCourt and starCourt 2n tan(π/n)(c/2 + w0/2)w0 with n the least side count of weight > 0; chordArc chords[0] x 1.5w0²; row, template, axisLocked, baseOutline, shelter, drawn no test; stepped ST0's Amin; ovalCourt π(a0b0 - (a0 - w0 - c0)(b0 - w0 - c0)); infeasible when Amin > 1.1 x hi (slotBand's upper target).

V02-0146.statement: M4 family: one draw (creation index 0) over families feasible by both tests, weights renormalised, ties keep row order; where some pass geometry but none the budget, the least-Amin one is taken without a draw and reported (overBudgetFamily; M10 shrinks it); none passing geometry -> M14's ladder from rung 2.

V02-0147.statement: M5 sunlit choice (item 102 (d); J-V2.38): where a family draws a coin between two mirror options (L arm end, T cross-wing end, U opening front or rear with base chance uOpenFront, towerHouse corner), each option's open vector o (L: arm toward front range's free end; T: cross-wing toward hall's free end; U: -v forecourt, +v rear; towerHouse: tower toward range's far end) weights x sunBias when o·sunDir > 0.25, x (1 - sunBias) when < -0.25, else unchanged, renormalised; sunDir = plan direction of the noon sun (0,-1) south (+y north) for positive latitude (§8.4 Sun.latitudeDeg), (0,+1) negative, none at 0; sunBias 0.7 (own, extension) and 0.5 in MFCG, FTG, VG, FM (each zeroing preset carries its entry since zeroing's 0 would weight every sun-facing option 0), where the coin is byte-identical to the unbiased one; orientation never changed.

V02-0148.statement: M5 slabs in the frame (cm; u0, v0 Rr's near corner and front; w drawn creation index 0 after the family, clamped; length cells drawn uniformly creation index 1 in the named order): single: if W < gableToStreetMaxFrontM and D >= W across the frontage L = clamp(rangeLenM, 1.2w, D), slab [u0 + (W - w)/2, u0 + (W + w)/2] x [v0, v0 + L]; else along L = clamp(rangeLenM, 1.2w, W), slab [u0 + (W - L)/2, u0 + (W + L)/2] x [v0, v0 + w]; fallLine and water always along u. L: front slab [a, a + Lf] x [v0, v0 + w], Lf = clamp(rangeLenM, 2w, W), a = u0 + (W - Lf)/2; coin left or right; Ls = clamp(rangeLenM, 2w, D); side slab [end - w, end] x [v0 + w, v0 + Ls] (right) or [a, a + w] (left); front through (main), side abuts (range). T: fwd, back from crossWing; hall [a, e] x [v0 + fwd, v0 + fwd + w] (main); cross [e, e + w] x [v0, v0 + fwd + w + back] (cross); e - a = Lh = clamp(rangeLenM, 1.4w, W - w), a centring the whole; coin cross-wing end; needs fwd + w + back <= D else fwd and back shrink proportionally, fails M3 at 0. H: T with a cross slab at each end, Lh + 2w <= W.

V02-0149.statement: M5 slabs (cont.): U: coin with uOpenFront; Lf = clamp(rangeLenM, 3w, W), Ls = clamp(rangeLenM, 2w, D); rear-open: front slab through (main), arms [a, a + w] and [a + Lf - w, a + Lf] x [v0 + w, v0 + Ls] (range); front-open (forecourt): back slab [a, a + Lf] x [v0 + Ls - w, v0 + Ls] through (main), arms v0 to v0 + Ls - w, entrance hint the back range's side facing the frontage across the forecourt. cross: main slab [a, a + Lm] x [c - w/2, c + w/2], Lm = clamp(rangeLenM, 3w, W), c = v0 + Lc/2; cross slab [a + (Lm - w)/2, a + (Lm + w)/2] x [v0, v0 + Lc], Lc = clamp(rangeLenM, 3w, D); main runs through; cross laid as two pieces abutting (role cross, consecutive keys): three wings in two path segments. rectCourt: Lf = clamp(rangeLenM, max(2w + courtMinM, 3w), W), Ld likewise on D; path order front, rear, left, right (front and rear through, sides abut both); court >= courtMinM a side.

V02-0150.statement: M5 plotRing: H simplified toward at most 8 vertices at tolerance w/4 removing only a vertex whose removal keeps the ring inside H (orient2d §3.2); each edge's line moved inward by w/2; consecutive lines intersected give path Q; rejected (new attempt M14, drawing w afresh on massing/attempt=a) unless Q simple, every edge >= 1.5w, every interior angle >= mitreMinDeg (60°), Q inset again by w/2 leaves a court each side >= courtMinM; one slab per edge, mitre joints; edge nearest the access is the gate range. gridWalk: g x g grid (g = gridCells 4) fitted to Rr, pitch p = min(W,D)/g, required p >= w + max(walkGapM, 0.3w) (else g - 1 to 3, else infeasible); starts on a random front-row cell; at each step stops with chance min(1, walkStop x max(0, segments - walkFree)) (walkStop 0.12, walkFree 0, own; stops certainly only at nine; FM values calibrated at M6c against the reference's segment distribution), else tries unvisited in-bounds neighbours in an order drawn once per step; collinear steps merge; no move from start -> single; one slab per segment; earlier segment runs through at each turn.

V02-0151.statement: M5 towerHouse: coin front corner; shape by towerShape; square tower rect slab of side t = clamp(1.2w .. 2w) (role tower, roof pyramid); round polygon ring radius t/2 (roof cone); octagonal 8-gon circumradius t/2; where rangeLenM[1] > 0 an attached range (main) of length clamp(rangeLenM, 1.5w, W - t) along u (square abutting, butt; round or octagonal overlapping by 0.35 x t/2); no range: the tower is the whole building. regularCourt (fantasy): side count by sides weights, circumradius R = (min(W,D) - w)/2 x U(0.8,1), centre Rr's centre, vertices at angles θ0 + 2πk/n by dmath (§6.5), θ0 putting one side parallel to f nearest the frontage; mitre. starCourt (fantasy): corner count by weights, radius R x U(0.55,1), angle θ0 + (k + U(0.25,0.75)) x 2π/n; mitre; rejected (M14) when an interior angle < mitreMinDeg. chordArc (fantasy): k chords by chords, polygon order m = U{k+1..8}, first k chords of a regular m-gon scaled so the chain's box fits Rr less w/2, convex side toward the frontage; mitre; free ends square.

V02-0152.statement: M5 stepped: massStepped (V2 §3.15.1), the one exported function the base outline builder also calls from M3a, runs this frame, slotBand, ST0 (M3 for stepped), drawTiers on creation indices 8-9, layTiers (ST2-ST7), ST8 (M10 for stepped) and the stepped attempts (M14 on massing/attempt=a) itself, returning wings and MassingRef; ST4 gives heights and roofs (M11 and M12 not run on them, no cupola), ST6 and ST7 checks, keys, hint (M13's); M7-M9 lay nothing; of M8b's attached structures an absorbed one adds its budget share and lays nothing, any other dropped and reported (attachedDropped).

V02-0153.statement: M5 ovalCourt: massOval (exported by @plat/plots beside massStepped, called by the base outline builder from M3a (second fixture's arena, BCR-V2-39) and by this step from M6a, same bytes): runs the frame, slotBand, M3's ovalCourt test, the construction, M11's and M12's ovalCourt rules, M13's checks, falling to rectCourt (from M6a; base court-institution construction at M3a) on failure; w at creation index 0 (façade width); then at index 1 in order major semi-axis factor U(0.85, 1), axis ratio ρ = U(1.15, 1.4), seating depth c = U(caveaM); major axis along Rr's longer side L (shorter S), centred: a = L/2 x factor, b = a / ρ; where 2b > S, b = S/2 and a = min(L/2, b x ρ); side count n by ovalSides bracket on (a + b)/2: 12 below 10 m, 16 below 20 m, 20 above (own); outer polygon P0 n vertices at θi = π/n + 2πi/n on the ellipse (dmath) so chords (n-1, 0) and (n/2-1, n/2) are centred on the major axis; P1 each edge line moved inward by w (2 x 2 solves); P2 each P1 edge line moved inward by c clamped to at most b - w - courtMinM/2 (clamp below caveaM[0] is the M3 failure, an M14 attempt).

V02-0154.statement: ovalCourt wings: façade i = quad (P0i, P0i+1, P1i+1, P1i), seating i = quad (P1i, P1i+1, P2i+1, P2i), ring-ordered with sides 1 and 3 mitred ends and 2 and 4 eaves (oblique-slab rule, every shared point one vertex, §2.6 rule 1); façade wings role range, storeyed, arcade where the row's arcade is on; seating wings role range and solid; the hole inside P2 is the court (the arena floor, typed court like any hole, BCR-V2-24, built M3a). Gates: the major-axis chord nearest the access is the main gate (façade wing role gate, seating wing laid storeyed one floor as the passage, role gate); the opposite major-axis chord's façade takes main and its seating wing the second passage (gate, one floor); entrance hint M13's rule on the main gate's façade wing outer side; no block, tower, turret, back range; segments = 2n.
used_by: V01 no pin on arena floor

V02-0155.statement: Slabs from a path (oblique families): segment i from p_i to p_i+1, unit direction d_i, left normal n_i; long sides at ± w/2; at a joint corners are intersections of neighbouring side lines (mitre line through the path vertex); free ends square; segments with interior angle >= 178° merge first; slab a quad wing ring-ordered corner(start,left) -> corner(start,right) -> corner(end,right) -> corner(end,left): sides 1 and 3 ends, 2 and 4 eaves; ridgeAxis 0 (ridge joins ends' midpoints; mitred end: the path vertex). Rectilinear families produce rect wings; at a butt joint the wing whose role has higher WingRoleRow.through runs through (ties: earlier in path). The main range of a closed family (rectCourt, plotRing, regularCourt, starCourt) is the range opposite the gate (largest +v midpoint component, ties by length then path order), role main (through 2); front range keeps gate; hall, court door, chapel end read it. Segment count after collinear merging before M7 (single, towerHouse, pass-throughs 1; T 2; H 3; cross 2; closed ring its edge count) written by M13 to MassingRef.segments. M6 merged into M5.

V02-0156.statement: M7 blocks (rectilinear families and a plotRing's gate range): k drawn in blocks (creation index 2); candidates with weights: midpoint of a range >= 3w long (1, or 2 on main or gate), free end of a range (1), outer corner of a butt joint (1.5 closed, 1 otherwise); drawn by weight without replacement; per block lb = w x U(1, 1.6) along host, db = w x U(1, 1.4) across (proud by (db - w)/2 each side); accept when inside H, 1 m from every accepted block and tower, each remaining host piece >= max(w/2, 2 m) (shorter absorbed into the block); accepted splits its host into up to two pieces with the host's role and new keys (rect pieces of a rect host; quad pieces of a quad host keeping the mitred end and ending square on the block); block a rect wing role block aligned with its host's eave; at a corner replaces the corner square; pieces and block tile the union (pairing §2.6 rule 4 (ii)); piece-end vertices on the block's side recorded in its corners (§2.6 rule 1); block roof always hip (item 59 ADOPTED; J-V2.3), ridge along the longer of lb, db, ends inset by WingRoleRow.hipInset x span.

V02-0157.statement: M8 towers (collision set holds the wings, item 59): k drawn in towers (creation index 3), shape by towerShape; candidates: (a) every convex corner of the union where two ranges meet and each free corner of a range (weight 2 on rectCourt, plotRing, U, fantasy closed; 1 otherwise); (b) midpoint of each free end (1); (c) midpoint of the gate or main range's street side only with chance gateTower; (d) tower on a block (centroid of each accepted block, weight towerOnBlock, 0 default, square); radius r = w x towerRadiusW drawn; (a)-(c) centre outward by 0.35r along the corner bisector or side normal; ring side count by TowerShapeRow radius bracket (round 12 below 2 m, 16 below 4 m, 24 above; square 4 aligned with host; octagon 8 one side parallel), dmath vertices snapped. Accepted only if (i) inside H; (ii) area share inside the wings' union in [0.2, 0.6]; (iii) centre inside no wing deeper than 0.35r from its boundary; (iv) 0.5 m from every other tower and block; (v) seed contract (§2.6): every tower vertex >= attractCm from every wing side it does not cross and vice versa, else centre moves once by 2 x attractCm outward and re-tested.

V02-0158.statement: M8 (d) acceptance: a square of side min(lb, db) x U(0.5, 0.8) centred on the block, inside the block ring inset by towerOnBlockInsetM (0.3 m), 0.5 m from other towers; contained in its block (clip order after its container, §2.6 containment rule), its room inside the block's piece; M11 raises it until its eave stands above the block's ridge. Candidates tried in drawn order until k accepted or none remain (fewer accepted reported, never retried). Stair turret: chance turret, one turret radius U(1.2, 1.8) m at a re-entrant corner (inner corner of L, T, H, U, cross), same tests with share band [0.25, 0.75]; role turret.

V02-0159.statement: M8 (e) template towers (church, cathedral, cloister rows and any template row with westTowers[1] > 0 or crossingTower > 0): west end = free end of the template's nave part (nave or the longest part) whose ridge end lies farthest toward world west (-x); west tower count = the attached tower/towers structure's drawn count (M8b) raised to the row's westTowers[0] (a cathedral always has two), else a draw in westTowers; one west tower a square of side w_n x U(0.45, 0.6) centred on the west end's midpoint standing out 0.35 x side; two at the west end's corners each standing out diagonally 0.35 x side; crossing tower (chance crossingTower, where the template has part crossing, BCR-V3-13 names) a square of the crossing's shorter side less 2 x towerOnBlockInsetM, contained in the crossing part; template towers pass tests (i), (iv), (v) (west towers also (ii)); a failing one moves inward by attractCm steps at most 4, then dropped and reported. Towers and turrets are polygon wings (square tower a 4-vertex aligned polygon), first in the canonical wing order (J-V2.4).

V02-0160.statement: M8b attached structures (BCR-V2-29), each template structure whose roleKeys row says attach main arrives in BuildingInput.attached with S11's drawn count: wheel (watermill wheel housing): rect wing role service, one storey, width U(2, 3) m, length along the water side min(main range's water-side length - 1 m, 6 m), centred, reaching from the main range's water-side wall to H's boundary on the water side (at most wheelReachM 4 m), roof shed high against the mill house; needs the water axis frame, without a water edge laid on the rear side and reported. sails (windmill): no wing, main family forced to towerHouse with no range (windmill override sets shape weights), sails a §8.10 decoration. westTower: the count M8 (e) reads. churchPorch: rect wing role service, one storey, width U(3, 4.5) m, depth U(3, 5) m, on the main entrance's side of the nave centred on the door, inside H; where laid, the entrance hint names its outer side and the composer lays no porch there.

V02-0161.statement: M8b absorbed (a court institution's ranges): no geometry; the count raises the main family's least range count; M10's budget for the main slot takes the absorbed shares. On an ovalCourt (an arena's gates; J-V2.88) an absorbed structure raises no range count: its budget share joins the main slot's; the drawn gate count g (2-4, V11 §3.6.1) sets the passages: the first two are M5's major-axis gate passages; a third turns the seating wing of the minor-axis chord (n/4 - 1, n/4) or (3n/4 - 1, 3n/4) (centred on the minor axis, n a multiple of 4) nearer the access into a one-floor gate passage, façade keeping its role; a fourth the other; massOval reads g from BuildingInput.attached (2 where absent) so the M3a builder lays the same bytes. An attached wing passes M13's checks like any wing; a failing one is dropped and reported, the building kept.

V02-0162.statement: M9 back range: with chance backRange (creation index 4), host = main range (a row: the front quad); rear side = host ring side whose outward normal has the largest +v component, independent of the ridge (J-V2.40): a row quad side 4 (rear chain) on gable- or eaves-fronted rows, a detached host the side farthest from the access; attaching run = that side's longest straight run (chain: longest sub-run with direction varying <= 5°); width wb = clamp(backWidthM, 3 m, run - 0.6 m); length lb = clamp(backLenM, 2 m, reach - 1 m), reach = free depth of the back region behind the run (row: V2 §3.4 step 5's back region; else H); a row's stands flush against one party wall (a coin), a detached house's flush against the side nearer the larger side yard; rect wing role back abutting (butt) the host's rear side, vertices inserted into the host ring; floors host's less one (>= 1); roof shed (high against host) when wb <= 3.5 m else gable along its length.

V02-0163.statement: M10 size budget (J-V2.35): A = union area (sum of tiled wings less towers' overlaps, measured exactly by the kernel boolean only when towers exist); target band [lo, hi] = [p10, p90] x footprintShare_i / count_i x buildingScale x sizeFactor ([p10, p90] = template footprintM2 at the significance-shifted value; where p10 = p50 = p90, [sizeBandLo x p50, sizeBandHi x p50] with sizeBandLo/Hi = 0.7 and 1.45 fixed (V11 §3.6.1 derivation ratios; SCC-R0C-3); footprintShare_i the structure's share (V11 role table; absent: main slot 0.6 when other structures are drawn else 1, other slots equal parts of the rest) plus absorbed shares; count_i the drawn count; sizeFactor the SIZE ladder step's (item 108) else 1). Claim-sized (J-V2.87): where the row carries claimShare or the template's footprintM2 is 'the claim's' (V11 §3.6.1 cathedral, cloister, castle families, precinct institutions), [lo, hi] = claimShare x area(H) x sizeFactor (row's claimShare else constants claimLo, claimHi 0.35, 0.6); on a deck plot the deck row's band; narrowed by drift areaPct; cap = coverageMax x area(H); the whole band is slotBand (@plat/plots) read by M3, ST0, ST8, M10.

V02-0164.statement: M10 ladder: (1) if A > 1.1 x min(hi, cap): every M5 path length scaled by sqrt(min(hi, cap)/A) with M5's clamp lower bounds lowered to the family's M3 least, M5-M9 re-run once with the same draws; (2) still over: drop blocks, then towers; (3) still over: reverse lattice rectCourt, plotRing, regularCourt, starCourt -> U -> L -> single; H -> T -> single; cross -> T -> single; gridWalk, chordArc -> L -> single; towerHouse -> the tower alone; stepped -> single (ST8); ovalCourt -> rectCourt -> U -> L -> single, re-running M5-M9 at each step on massing/attempt=a continuing M14's counter; (4) end of lattice still over: accept and report overBudget by class. If A < 0.9 x lo: path lengths scale up by min(sqrt(lo/A), largest factor keeping the massing in Rr) once; still under: accept and report (underSize and JOIN are the mutator's, never the massing's).

V02-0165.statement: M11 heights: main floors fm = template floors interpolated along the value, rounded stochastically (creation index 5: floor(x + u)), clamped into template and drift ranges; each wing floors = fm + a draw in WingRoleRow.storeyDelta (block blockStoreyDelta; tower/turret towerStoreyDelta above the tallest wing it overlaps), >= 1; all ranges of one closed or oblique path share fm. Tower storeys: a tower of a family whose HeightsRow carries towerStoreys (church, chapel, cathedral, cloister, tower, castle; V11 §3.6.4) takes floors uniformly in that range (creation index 5 after fm), each of towerStoreyCm (BCR-V2-26; else storeyCm.upper). Heights from V11's HeightsRow keyed by template family (J-V2.33): eaveCm = storeyCm.ground + (floors - 1) x storeyCm.upper (+ parapetCm on flat); ridgeCm: gable and hip eave + pitch x span/2 (quad: mean of end sides), shed eave + pitch x span at high, pyramid and cone eave + towerPitch x r, tent eave + pitch x r, flat eave.

V02-0166.statement: One pitch rule (J-V2.33): range pitch = HeightsRow.roofPitch x (ClimateRow.roof.pitch / pitchRef) clamped [0.3, 1.8], ClimateRow the site's (§4.9, V11 §2.8), pitchRef the temperate-deciduous row's roof.pitch; towers TowerShapeRow.pitch; spires as M12; never a material's (item 19). A tower's or turret's floors raised further until its eave >= the highest wing roof point inside its ring (tower on a block above its ridge; occlusion rule V2 §5.2). A wing spanning a passage keeps the base's two-floor minimum (§2.5 Passage). An arcade wing keeps its storeys, ground storey open (dashed, exported open, outside capacity's ground storey). Under a vault (underground layer, V04 chamber ceiling incl. an arch vault's soffit under a raised way, X29): floors clamped so the eave stays >= vaultClampCm (30 cm) below it, reported vaultClamp. ovalCourt: façade ring shares fm; each seating wing solid (floors 0) with eaveCm = storeyCm.ground and ridgeCm = the façade's eaveCm; gate passage wing floors 1, same eave and ridge. baseCm = base deriveBase called by S11 after the massing (crypt lift raises ground wings over the basement's ring; stacked building: rebaseStack, BCR-V2-32). Building Heights: towerCm highest tower or turret ridge above baseCm (absent without one); eaveCm, ridgeCm maxima over other wings; stacked building: the envelope of V2 §3.15.2 incl. floors.

V02-0167.statement: M12 roofs: range roles hip with chance hipShare else gable (one draw per closed or oblique path, one per wing otherwise; creation index 6); where ClimateRow.roof.form is flat (arid town) every range, block and back range takes flat with the family's parapetCm and no dormers; block always hip; towers cone (round) or pyramid (square, octagon), or with chance towerFlat (square, octagonal) flat with parapetCm (battlemented); spires: a tower of a family whose HeightsRow carries spireFactor takes a cone or pyramid spire of rise spireFactor x (eaveCm - baseCm), stored as the RoofSpec.pitch giving that rise over its radius; back as M9; shelter as M0; @underground forces flat. Cupola (creation index 7): with its chance a kind by weights on the main range (the longest main or gate range) written to MassingRef.cupola (derived solid at the ridge midpoint, never in Heights, never a caster). ovalCourt: façade flat with parapetCm, no draw; seating and gate-passage wings shed with high the side on P1 (outward), pitch = rise over span from M11. Ridge axis: along the path segment for a range; along the host for a block unless db > lb; a row quad ridgeAxis 1 (gable to street) with probability smoothstep((gableToStreetMaxFrontM + 1.5 - frontage) / 3) (own; share calibrated to NG's measured 36 % under parity, V2 §7.4).

V02-0168.statement: M13 snap and validate: every point snaps by §3.2's placement rule; a ring edge shorter than minEdge (25 cm) merges its end into its start; every wing vertex within the hot pixel of another wing's side inserted into it (§2.6 rule 1). Checks (exact on lattice points): every ring simple and counter-clockwise; every wing inside H; non-tower wings tile (pairing §2.6 rule 4 (ii); stepped: ground wings only, wings with on by ST6's containment); M8 (v) for towers; each wing >= 4 m² and each side >= minEdge; the laid range count before M7 lies in MassingFamilyRow.wings and every joint of its joints kind (J-V2.57; every family has its row incl. stepped and ovalCourt); ovalCourt: P0, P1, P2 simple and CCW, every edge >= minEdge, P2's least width >= courtMinM. Order and keys: towers and turrets (acceptance order), ranges in path order (gate else main first), blocks, back range, M8b attached; keys 0..n-1, nextWingKey = n (canonical order by construction); segments written. Entrance hint: the gate wing else main (church porch's outer side where laid), its eave side with the largest positive -v component (forecourt U: back range's; towerHouse without range: the square tower's front side), kept only if >= entranceHintMinCos (cos 60°) else null. A failing check is an M14 attempt.

V02-0169.statement: M14 ladder (F-MASSING; per building, never whole-map): rung 0 attempts 0, 1, 2 of the drawn family (concern cap 3), attempt a on massing/attempt=a; rung 1 each other feasible family by descending weight, one attempt each, continuing the attempt counter; rung 2 single with w = max(0.8 x wingWidthM[0], 3 m); rung 3 baseOutline (base rectangle in H, guaranteed by §2.6 with F-SITEPLAN above it); every rung past 0 counted per class in the generation report; no building refused; no retry beyond the building.

V02-0170.statement: compose(input, outline, 'wings', k) is a pure function of the wings rung's recorded inputs (wingsInputs: base wings, main entrance, massing reference, row slices, the porch's neighbourhood on the plot) and its own streams: (1) one Wing {base} per non-tower base wing in key order, one ComposedTower {base} per tower or turret wing; ring, heights, roof, spans read from the base wing, so the stage-3 contract (BCR-V2-22: union of composed wings and towers equals the outline's union; each composed wing reaches exactly its base wing's storeys) holds by construction; (2) courts = footprint face holes in ring order; (3) dormer rows on compose.dormers; (4) porch and secondary porch on compose.porch; (5) validation (F-COMPOSE, BCR-V2-16): each dormer inside its facet clear of every valley, hip, tower, block (roofscape regions); each porch inside the plot clear of other buildings, of the building's own other wings (stack's stair 0, an attached porch wing) and of every way; failures take V2 §3.13's ladder; nothing the composer makes is model data until an edit stores it.

V02-0171.statement: facadeBays (the one rhythm every reader shares; every side, J-V2.93): on an eave side usable run = side length less endMarginM (1.2 m; constants row, only home) at each end, less the projection of every tower ring, block and other wing meeting it widened by 0.6 m, less the reach of each valley ending on the side computed in integer cm by §6.5: for wing X whose ridge meets wing Y's roof e = floor((X.ridgeCm - Y.eaveCm) x Y.halfSpanCm / Y.riseCm) (never from the float roofscape, J-V2.25; byte-identical on every host, T-V2-13); run cut into nb = max(1, floor(run / bayM)) equal bays (bayM 3.6 m own), each {atCm centre from the side's first vertex, widthCm}. Other sides of rect or quad wings (gable end, free part along a butt joint): same less the valley term; a non-positive run has no bay. Polygon wings (tower, turret): bays round the ring's free perimeter (boundary less parts inside or within 0.6 m of another wing's ring), each maximal free arc cut into max(1, floor(arc / bayM)) bays by arc length (arc < bayM/2 none); facadeBays returns bays whose centres lie on that side. Pure, no draw; read by dormer positions (eaves), V03 W2 windows on every side, §8.4 lit windows when no plan, §8.10 decorative chimneys (eave sides; bay line nearest each end, hearths of them).

V02-0172.statement: Decorative chimneys on exposed roof only: at a bay line of a host wing's eave, up-slope by half the span; host a storeyed wing whose roof there is exposed (never solid; never inside the ring of a wing standing on the host); on a stacked building hearths placed on the top storeyed wing first (bay lines nearest each end, alternating), then the exposed terrace band of the storeyed wing below (bay lines whose chimney point lies outside every wing on it), and so down the stack; a count left with no exposed bay line dropped and reported (hearthsDropped).

V02-0173.statement: Dormer rows: a wing takes dormers only if its role allows (WingRoleRow.dormers: main, range, cross, gate, block), its roof is gable or hip (never under flat climate roofs) with pitch >= DormerKindRow.minPitch (0.7), and HeightsRow.attic is true (BCR-V2-26) or it has >= 2 floors. Per eave side (creation index 2 x key + eave on compose.dormers; nb and run from facadeBays): (1) n = clamp(round(perTenM x run/10 x U(0.75, 1.25)), 0, nb); (2) entrance gable on the main entrance's eave side with chance dormer.entranceGable: one entranceGable dormer width U(2.4, 3.6) m clamped to its bay, in the bay containing the main entrance (counts in n); (3) kinds by dormer.kinds; a warehouse family puts exactly one hoist dormer on each eave facing an access edge (outward normal component toward the access >= entranceHintMinCos), in the bay nearest that eave's centre; (4) width U(widthM) clamped to bay width - gapM (0.4 m); (5) positions dormerPositions (no draw): n bays symmetric about the run's centre (n = nb all; otherwise centre bay first when nb odd, then outward in pairs; odd remainder on even nb to the main-entrance side, else first side in ring order); a dormer whose plan rectangle (width x depthShare x span/2 up the slope, set back 0.3 m for dormer, at the eave for wallGable, entranceGable, hoist) meets a valley region, tower ring, cupola or other dormer is dropped (count falls, reported).

V02-0174.statement: Precedence against the plan: before a plan exists the rows are the dormers; once the plan rung has derived a plan an unedited DormerRow's count is the plan's count of top-storey roofed rooms with exterior demand under that eave (V03 W4) clamped to nb, kind and widthCm kept, positions by dormerPositions; an edited row stays a fixed input the plan honours; the drawing never shows a dormer the plan contradicts, a user's dormer edit always wins. Dormers never project past the eave line (J-V2.7): FM's projecting cross-gables would leave footprint and plot; the real projecting bay is a block (M7).

V02-0175.statement: Porch: only on the wing carrying the main entrance where WingRoleRow.porch admits (main, gate, range, cross, block; not tower, turret, back, service: a towerHouse entered through its tower or a church through its porch wing takes none); side and offset the main entrance's (base rule 3, re-read after every carry); d = free distance from the door point along the side's outward normal to the first of the plot's boundary, another footprint of the plot, or a footpath or forecourt yard part edge reaching a way (measured on the plot's own rings). Feasible: recessed where host depth >= 3 m + depthM[0]; hood where d >= depthM[0] + clearanceM (0.3 m); gabled, halfRound, twoStorey where d >= depthM[0] + clearanceM, side >= widthM[0] + 0.6 m, twoStorey needs >= 2 floors. One draw (creation index 0 on compose.porch) over porch weights restricted to feasible and none; width U(widthM) clamped to the side's free part (no other wing abuts; BCR-V2-38) less 0.6 m; depth U(depthM) clamped to d - clearanceM (outside) or host depth less 3 m (recessed); halfRound depth = width/2 with width/2 <= d - clearanceM; a flush row front (d = 0) takes recessed or none. Porch ring derived (rectangle on the side at the offset, outward or inward; halfRound half-disc radius width/2 centred on the door on the side's outer line, dmath arc with TowerShapeRow's round bracket side count halved, >= 6 segments); heights one storey (storeyCm.ground) and rise pitch x width/2 (twoStorey two storeys; halfRound half-cone at TowerShapeRow round pitch); drawn and lit where compositions are drawn; adds nothing to model heights.

V02-0176.statement: Secondary porch (J-V2.44): with chance secondaryPorch (creation index 1 on compose.porch) one hood at the side, rear or yard entrance (§2.6 Entrance.role) with the largest d among those where a hood is feasible, ties by entrance ordinal; size by PorchKindRow.hood; 0 in default rows (one porch at the main door), calibrated under FM (up to three porches per building).

V02-0177.statement: rooms rung derived only as the plan rung's input (compose(..., rooms) after wings on the plan-deriving click), never alone under view (J-V2.9); each room a Room (§2.6) with storey, composed wing's base key (a tower's room its tower wing's key) and a role V03's programme rows name (these four roles must exist there); all rooms inside one seed piece at their storey (stage-3 contract): each avoids every tower ring (shortened away else omitted) and keeps attractCm from every side it does not share. The rung reads the occupants (item 28 (f); J-V2.36): rooms cells at the occupants' band; recorded inputs include the occupants' band row and household count (BCR-V2-13): a band change or re-division marks it stale; hall and chapel emitted only where the interior-ladder row at the occupants' band gives unit form house (one household) or the class is an institution whose programme names a hall (inn common room, guild or town hall, market hall upper hall, barracks mess); a rich manor fallen to the poor band has no hall ring (T-V2-35), returning restores the as-built rooms exactly; gate hall and tower rooms stay at every band.

V02-0178.statement: Hall: in the main wing (closed family: range opposite the gate) eave to eave, length U(hallLenShare) x the wing's ridge length clamped to [1.4w, length - 2 m] then to the programme's area (class programme hall row [min, max] x interior-ladder sizeFactor at the occupants' band, by shortening its length never its width) where the class's RoomProgramRow hall rule is loaded (V03's rows from M6-P's P1); before those rows land (M6b) clamped by [1.4w, length - 2 m] alone and reported per building (hallUnclamped; J-V2.95); low end = the door it is entered by: the main entrance on the main wing at door offset - hallDoorBackM (1.5 m; cross-passage bay) clamped inside the wing; else a court door on the main range's court side at the offset nearest the gate hall's axis (derived opening the plan rung opens); runs toward the range's farther end; ground storey; role hall.
