V02-0206.statement: Constants row of composition.json (lines 1939-1970; own, calibratable unless noted): mitreMinDeg 60°; collinearMergeDeg 178°; wMinM 3 m, wMinShare 0.8; walkStop 0.12, walkFree 0, walkGapM 2 m; plotRingMaxVertices 8, plotRingTolW 0.25, plotRingMinEdgeW 1.5; blockLenW [1,1.6], blockDepthW [1,1.4], blockMinPiece max(w/2, 2 m), blockGapM 1 m; towerCentreOut 0.35 r, towerShare [0.2,0.6], turretShare [0.25,0.75], turretRadiusM [1.2,1.8] m, towerGapM 0.5 m, towerOnBlockInsetM 0.3 m, westTowerW [0.45,0.6]; wheelWidthM [2,3] m, wheelReachM 4 m, churchPorchWidthM [3,4.5] m, churchPorchDepthM [3,5] m; axisSlope 3 %, axisSampleM 2 m, axisWaterM 50 m; sunBias 0.7 (extension; 0.5 in MFCG, FTG, VG (own, fixed: the parity neutral) and FM (code-read)); backMinWidthM 3 m, backShedMaxWidthM 3.5 m, backFarMarginM 1 m, backRunTolDeg 5°; sizeLo 0.9, sizeHi 1.1, mainShareDefault 0.6; sizeBandLo 0.7, sizeBandHi 1.45 (own, fixed: the mirror of V11 §3.6.1's derivation ratios; not calibratable); pitchClamp [0.3,1.8]; entranceHintMinCos cos 60°; bayM 3.6 m, endMarginM 1.2 m, dormerSetbackM 0.3 m; hallDoorBackM 1.5 m, gateHallJointGapM 0.5 m; dormerEaveTol ± 10 %; domeRise 1.0; viewBatchMs 16 ms of pool time; crypt.clearCm 250 cm, crypt.freeboardCm 30 cm (BCR-V2-28); massing.composed option on; fantasyShapes off (§7.8, BCR-V2-30); tierMinSideM 3 m, landingM 1 m, stairClearM 0.3 m, stairGradeMax 1.3, pentShare 0.6; claimLo 0.35, claimHi 0.6; ovalSides 12/16/20 (below 10 m, below 20 m, above), ovalAxisRatio [1.15,1.4], ovalMajorFactor [0.85,1]; terrace.wallBandCm 250 cm; vaultClampCm 30 cm; riserMaxCm 20 cm; deck.fallbackM2 [20,60] m², deck.fallbackFloors 2 (until V11's deck row, X16).

V02-0207.statement: Register lines (J-V2.101): every calibratable cell takes its entry from exactly one line, written by the seat landing the milestone shipping the cell; a line ending 'and every other ...' binds the rest of its family; bar.T-V2-<n> is V12's bar-metric family (SCC-56, X33); other metrics V12 §3.4.2's; the panel rule is V12 §3.11's (no second value: a group rated No leaves not-achieved reported as a table defect, unrated provisional). Bars' registrations (J-V2.102): each bar named as bar.T-V2-<n> registered by the seat landing the milestone writing that line's entry, same change, as a V12 BenchBarDef (id, owner V02, statistic, stages ['S11'] so V12 §3.7.2 (4) admits exactly V02's cells, towns (fixtures with settings, preset default PresetArm, no parity preset; perSetting the bar's own count else the fixture family's), tier, run = V2 §7's check) unless a StatBarSpec or NullModelSpec already carries it (none does); a two-tier bar registers once per tier under one id (vector passing only when each passes); a bar named by two lines registers once with the earlier; in T-V2-36, T-V2-42, T-V2-46 a clause whose subject is not yet produced reads -1 and is left out of the verdict (notApplicable when none applies), its entry not due before that landing.

V02-0208.statement: Bar registrations table (lines 1996-2008, md5 per build): T-V2-22 (V2 §6.1's four times then §6.2's four, ms; B-CITY every rung; nightly; M6b seat viewBatchMs); T-V2-28 (share of cluster and @underground buildings meeting one-wing one-roof; B-MASS; pr; M6a seat crypt line); T-V2-29 (least within-class Spearman, non-decreasing check, hovel's single share, rich manors' court share, towers where no row allows; B-CITY every rung; nightly; M6a geometry rows); T-V2-30 (share inside [0.9 x lo, 1.1 x hi]; B-MASS vs compiled V11 templates and B-CITY; pr and nightly, two registrations; M6a); T-V2-32 (short-axis ridge share; B-CITY-lite; nightly; M6c gableToStreetMaxFrontM); T-V2-36 (clauses 1/0, -1 until V04's access draw and crypt derivation at M6-U; B-MASS cathedrals on dry, low, damp, flood plots and stepped great temples on flood; nightly; M6a crypt line); T-V2-37 (south-facing share at sunBias 0.7 then 0.5; B-MASS flat northern site latitude 50°, 200 slots; pr; M6a); T-V2-42 (landmark clauses, arena hull aspect, court share, floor court typing, closure; -1 before M6a; B-MASS sub-fixtures and B-PLAN, second fixture; pr and milestone; M3a-V2 arena line); T-V2-46 (tiersTruncated share per anchor then clauses; B-MASS stepped sub-fixture 200 per anchor, second fixture; pr and milestone; M3a-V2 stepped line); T-V2-47 (in-band share then clauses; B-MASS deck sub-fixture, second fixture; M3a-V2 @deck line); T-V2-51 (clauses (a)-(c) shares; terrace-wall sub-fixture and second fixture's terraced wards; M3a-V2 terrace.wallBandCm).

V02-0209.statement: Register lines table (lines 2010-2027): geometry cells of template-family, override, role and default rows, @underground rows, shared cells and every other calibratable cell of those rows: measure at M6a (T-V2-29, T-V2-30 on B-CITY; §3.10.3 receipt re-run on compiled V11 templates), panel at M6 (V2 §7.5 (2)), corpus possibility at M-CAL; metrics bldg.area, bar.T-V2-29, bar.T-V2-30; cannot confirm -> M10 band and shrink keep each building in budget, SP-V2-1's rich join step, else panel rule. gableToStreetMaxFrontM: measure at M6c (T-V2-32 NG ridge share); none stated (not-achieved reported; NG sheet keeps X14's fallback). Code-read FM entries, mirror constants sizeBandLo/Hi, parity-neutral sunBias 0.5: no entry (provenance or fixed note passes the lint).
